 c.save();c.beginPath();c.rect(0,0,w,h);c.clip();

 if(light==='blue'){c.fillStyle='#10305655';c.fillRect(0,0,w,h)}if(light==='golden'){let sun=c.createRadialGradient(w*.73,h*.3,0,w*.73,h*.3,w*.67);sun.addColorStop(0,'#e8a96618');sun.addColorStop(1,'#eeaf6600');c.fillStyle=sun;c.fillRect(0,0,w,h)}

}

function setMilestone(i){state.mid=Math.max(0,Math.min(milestones.length-1,Number(i)));let m=milestones[state.mid];$('#timelineScrub').value=state.mid;$('#momentYear').textContent=m[0];$('#momentTitle').textContent=m[1];$('#momentBody').textContent=m[2];$('#momentLink').href=sources[m[4]][1];$$('.tick').forEach((b,j)=>b.classList.toggle('active',j===state.mid));if(state.act!==m[3])changeAct(m[3],false)}

function updateStudio(){if(!state.entered)return;$$('[data-shot]').forEach(b=>{b.classList.toggle('selected',b.dataset.shot===state.shot);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',b.dataset.shot===state.shot)});$$('[data-light]').forEach(b=>{b.classList.toggle('selected',b.dataset.light===state.light);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',b.dataset.light===state.light)});$('#gridSwitch').classList.toggle('on',state.grid);$('#gridSwitch').setAttribute('aria-checked',state.grid);$('#moveSwitch').classList.toggle('on',state.move);$('#moveSwitch').setAttribute('aria-checked',state.move);$('#labShotTag').textContent='SHOT / '+state.shot.toUpperCase();$('#labLightTag').textContent='LIGHT / '+({golden:'GOLDEN HOUR',blue:'TWILIGHT',mono:'BLACK & WHITE'}[state.light]);let read={wide:['The wide shot','The surroundings remain important. You can see where the people are, the distance to the train, and how small they are within the larger world.','What does the environment add?','A wide shot can communicate scale, isolation, freedom or anticipation—but context determines how it feels.'],medium:['The medium shot','The people become easier to read. Their posture and responses begin to share attention with the background.','Who are we watching?','Medium framing often balances human action with the situation around it. It does not have a fixed emotional meaning.'],close:['The close-up','Attention narrows toward the figures and their gestures. The surrounding location becomes less visible, making the viewer work with fewer environmental clues.','What is being withheld?','A close-up can create intimacy, pressure, uncertainty or focus depending on performance, lighting, editing and sound.']}[state.shot];$('#analysisTitle').textContent=read[0];$('#analysisCopy').textContent=read[1];$('#analysisQuestion').textContent=read[2];$('#analysisQuestionCopy').textContent=read[3];$('#labSubtitle').textContent={wide:'Observe the person and their world.',medium:'Notice the reaction inside the landscape.',close:'What is happening just outside the frame?'}[state.shot]}
function setDecision(k){state.decision=k;$$('[data-choice]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.choice===k));$('#decisionFeedback').textContent=({anticipation:'POSSIBLE EFFECT · Viewers notice the approaching train before the characters do. That gap in knowledge can generate anticipation—but the scene might become more about waiting than discovery.',surprise:'POSSIBLE EFFECT · By withholding the train, you can let the reveal arrive as a visual surprise. The moment of the cut matters, and the wider space stays uncertain until then.',curiosity:'POSSIBLE EFFECT · A reaction-first approach asks viewers to search for what the characters have noticed. A gradual reveal can make their curiosity guide ours.'})[k]}

function selectPerson(i){state.network=i;let p=people[i];$('#connRole').textContent=p.role;$('#connName').textContent=p.name;$('#connDesc').textContent=p.desc;$('#connSource').href=sources[p.source][1];$$('.n-group').forEach((g,j)=>g.classList.toggle('sel',i===j));$$('#connPills button').forEach((g,j)=>g.classList.toggle('active',i===j))}

function adapt(canvas,name){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();if(!r.width||!r.height)return null;const d=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(r.width*d));canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(r.height*d));let c=canvas.getContext('2d');c.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);W[name]=[r.width,r.height,d];return c}

 if(a===4){gradient(c,w,h,'#2c2a36','#946454');for(let k=0;k<5;k++){let x=w*.34+k*w*.14+Math.sin(t*.1)*3,y=h*.26+(k%2)*h*.11;rect(c,x-8,y-7,w*.12,h*.5,'#121923');rect(c,x,y,w*.10,h*.45,'#baa184');landscapeInset(c,x,y,w*.10,h*.45,t+k*10);rect(c,x+5,y+h*.46,w*.09,2,'#14171d')}figure(c,w*.83,h*.92,2.5,'#171a1d')}
 if(a===5){gradient(c,w,h,'#172638','#6a6872');let cx=w*.68,cy=h*.48;ellipse(c,cx,cy,Math.min(w,h)*.32,Math.min(w,h)*.32,'#cca57444');ellipse(c,cx,cy,Math.min(w,h)*.2,Math.min(w,h)*.2,'#222934');ellipse(c,cx,cy,Math.min(w,h)*.065,Math.min(w,h)*.065,'#bca891');for(let k=0;k<6;k++){let an=k*Math.PI/3+(state.motion?t*.035:0);ellipse(c,cx+Math.cos(an)*Math.min(w,h)*.14,cy+Math.sin(an)*Math.min(w,h)*.14,Math.min(w,h)*.045,Math.min(w,h)*.045,'#4c555d')}rect(c,w*.41,h*.82,w*.59,h*.08,'#15191f')}

}

 if(compare){c.save();c.beginPath();c.rect(0,0,w*compareAt,h);c.clip();renderArtwork(c,w,h,studioImg,'wide','golden',t);c.restore();c.save();c.beginPath();c.rect(w*compareAt,0,w*(1-compareAt),h);c.clip();renderArtwork(c,w,h,studioImg,state.shot,state.light,t);c.restore();const x=w*compareAt;c.fillStyle='#f3d6a6';c.fillRect(x-1,0,2,h);c.fillStyle='#e9c28b';c.beginPath();c.arc(x,h*.52,18,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();c.fillStyle='#111920';c.font='bold 17px Georgia';c.textAlign='center';c.fillText('↔',x,h*.52+6);c.textAlign='left';c.font='bold 10px monospace';c.fillStyle='#ffe8c7';c.fillText('ORIGINAL',17,h-19);c.textAlign='right';c.fillText('YOUR CUT',w-17,h-19);c.textAlign='left'}
 else renderArtwork(c,w,h,studioImg,state.shot,state.light,t);
 if(state.grid){c.save();c.strokeStyle='rgba(245,228,192,.62)';c.lineWidth=1;[1/3,2/3].forEach(v=>{c.beginPath();c.moveTo(w*v,0);c.lineTo(w*v,h);c.moveTo(0,h*v);c.lineTo(w,h*v);c.stroke()});c.restore()}
 let vg=c.createRadialGradient(w*.5,h*.5,w*.1,w*.5,h*.5,w*.8);vg.addColorStop(0,'#00000000');vg.addColorStop(1,'#02050966');c.fillStyle=vg;c.fillRect(0,0,w,h)
}
function renderScenes(t){if(state.entered&&state.view==='studio')drawLab(t)}
function loop(now){renderScenes(now/1000);if(state.motion)raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
function toggleMotion(){state.motion=!state.motion;$('#motionBtn').classList.toggle('active',state.motion);$('#motionBtn').title=state.motion?'Pause visual motion':'Resume visual motion';$('#motionBtn').setAttribute('aria-label',state.motion?'Pause visual motion':'Resume visual motion');$('#motionBtn').innerHTML=state.motion?'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" fill="none"><path d="M9 5v14M15 5v14"/></svg>':'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" fill="none"><path d="m8 5 12 7-12 7z"/></svg>';cancelAnimationFrame(raf);if(state.motion)raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);else renderScenes(performance.now()/1000)}
createRail();buildTimeline();buildNetwork();selectPerson(3);drawAct();setMilestone(0);$('#noteText').value=state.notes;
$('#beginBtn').onclick=()=>enter('journey');$('#tryLabBtn').onclick=()=>enter('studio');$('#homeBtn').onclick=portal;$('#brandBtn').onclick=portal;$('#motionBtn').onclick=toggleMotion;$('#soundBtn').onclick=toggleAmbient;
$$('.navtab').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>switchView(b.dataset.view));$('#chapterPrev').onclick=()=>changeAct(state.act-1);$('#chapterNext').onclick=()=>changeAct(state.act+1);$('#revealBtn').onclick=()=>{let e=$('#lessonText'),visible=!e.classList.toggle('hidden');$('#revealBtn').textContent=visible?'Hide creative lesson ↑':'Uncover the creative lesson ↓';$('#revealBtn').setAttribute('aria-expanded',visible)};
$('#bookmarkBtn').onclick=()=>{if(state.saved.has(state.act)){state.saved.delete(state.act);toast('Removed from Field Notes')}else{state.saved.add(state.act);toast('Act saved to Field Notes')}save();drawAct()};$('#jumpStudio').onclick=()=>switchView('studio');$('#timelineScrub').oninput=e=>setMilestone(e.target.value);
$$('[data-shot]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{state.shot=b.dataset.shot;updateStudio();if(!state.motion)renderScenes(performance.now()/1000)});$$('[data-light]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{state.light=b.dataset.light;updateStudio();if(!state.motion)renderScenes(performance.now()/1000)});
$('#gridSwitch').onclick=()=>{state.grid=!state.grid;updateStudio();if(!state.motion)renderScenes(performance.now()/1000)};$('#moveSwitch').onclick=()=>{state.move=!state.move;updateStudio()};$('#resetStudio').onclick=()=>{state.shot='wide';state.light='golden';state.grid=false;state.move=true;updateStudio();toast('Studio reset')};$$('[data-choice]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>setDecision(b.dataset.choice));
$('#noteText').addEventListener('input',e=>{state.notes=e.target.value;save();$('#noteSaved').textContent='Changes saved locally'});$('#exportNotes').onclick=exportNotes;
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>resizeAll(),{passive:true});document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!state.entered||e.target.closest('input,textarea,button,[role="button"]'))return;if(state.view==='journey'&&e.key==='ArrowRight')changeAct(state.act+1);if(state.view==='journey'&&e.key==='ArrowLeft')changeAct(state.act-1)});

// Cinematic screening room: keyboard, click, touch, and documented sources.
for(let i=0;i<milestones.length;i++){let b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.setAttribute('aria-label',`View milestone ${i+1}: ${milestones[i][1]}`);b.addEventListener('click',()=>{projectorIndex=i;paintProjector()});document.getElementById('projectorTrack').appendChild(b)}
document.getElementById('openProjector').onclick=()=>openProjector(state.mid);
document.getElementById('stageProject').onclick=()=>{const m=milestones.findIndex(m=>m[3]===state.act);openProjector(Math.max(0,m))};
document.getElementById('closeProjector').onclick=closeProjector;
document.getElementById('projectorPrev').onclick=()=>changeProjector(-1);
document.getElementById('projectorNext').onclick=()=>changeProjector(1);
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(document.getElementById('projector').classList.contains('hidden'))return;if(e.key==='Escape')closeProjector();if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')changeProjector(-1);if(e.key==='ArrowRight')changeProjector(1);if(e.key==='Tab'){const els=[...document.getElementById('projector').querySelectorAll('button:not(:disabled),a[href]')];if(els.length){if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===els[0]){e.preventDefault();els.at(-1).focus()}else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===els.at(-1)){e.preventDefault();els[0].focus()}}}});
let sx=0;document.getElementById('projector').addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{sx=e.touches[0].clientX},{passive:true});document.getElementById('projector').addEventListener('touchend',e=>{let diff=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-sx;if(Math.abs(diff)>60)changeProjector(diff<0?1:-1)},{passive:true});
// Before/after Director's Comparison.
document.getElementById('compareSwitch').onclick=()=>{compare=!compare;document.getElementById('compareSwitch').classList.toggle('on',compare);document.getElementById('compareSwitch').setAttribute('aria-checked',String(compare));document.getElementById('compareRange').classList.toggle('hidden',!compare);document.getElementById('compareLabel').classList.toggle('hidden',!compare);renderScenes(performance.now()/1000)};
document.getElementById('compareRange').oninput=e=>{compareAt=Number(e.target.value)/100;document.getElementById('compareValue').textContent=e.target.value+'%';renderScenes(performance.now()/1000)};
document.getElementById('captureFrame').onclick=()=>{renderScenes(performance.now()/1000);const a=document.createElement('a');a.download='ORIGIN-directors-frame.png';a.href=document.getElementById('labCanvas').toDataURL('image/png');a.click();toast('Your original Studio frame was saved')};
const origReset=document.getElementById('resetStudio').onclick;document.getElementById('resetStudio').onclick=()=>{origReset();compare=false;compareAt=.5;document.getElementById('compareSwitch').classList.remove('on');document.getElementById('compareSwitch').setAttribute('aria-checked','false');document.getElementById('compareRange').classList.add('hidden');document.getElementById('compareLabel').classList.add('hidden');document.getElementById('compareRange').value='50';document.getElementById('compareValue').textContent='50%';renderScenes(performance.now()/1000)};
// Pointer-based visual depth, disabled for reduced-motion visitors.
const portalEl=document.getElementById('portal');portalEl.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!state.motion||matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches)return;const r=portalEl.getBoundingClientRect();portalEl.style.setProperty('--px',((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5).toFixed(2));portalEl.style.setProperty('--py',((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5).toFixed(2))},{passive:true});

resizeAll();if(state.motion)raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);else renderScenes(0);
